slices.title: Materialize KP Asset Calculus run contract
slices.summary: Created the approved KP Asset Calculus run contract and recorded the approved long-loop queue.

slices.title: Write KP Asset Calculus doctrine spec
slices.summary: Added the active doctrine for semantic assets, transformations, diagrams, behaviors, interpreters, ports, flashcards, composition forms, time denotation, boundaries, and the linear-solve vertical proof target.

slices.title: Write KP Asset Calculus composition law spec
slices.summary: Added composition laws for object identity, selector closure, provenance, transformations, diagrams, behaviors, interpreters, ports, flashcards, law levels, and failure policy.

slices.title: Write LLM authoring guide for KP assets
slices.summary: Added a practical guide for LLM and human authors covering object, selector, transformation, diagram, behavior, interpreter, port, decomposition, flashcard, review, and anti-pattern rules.

slices.title: Expose Asset Calculus framework rows in the dashboard
slices.summary: Added dashboard work and protocol-gallery rows for KP Asset Calculus doctrine, composition laws, and the asset authoring guide, with search, preview, and Theseus adapter coverage.

slices.title: Define core SemanticObject asset interfaces
slices.summary: Added the first KP asset core module with semantic asset objects, selectors, bundles, provenance, diagnostics, selector lookup, and structural validation for duplicate ids and selector closure.

slices.title: Define SemanticTransformation source and target contracts
slices.summary: Added KP semantic transformation contracts with source and target object ids, preservation tags, selector correspondence, law refs, endpoint validation, and adjacent sequencing compatibility checks.

slices.title: Define SemanticDiagram composition forms
slices.summary: Added semantic diagram composition for transformation leaves, sequences, parallels, tree substitution, source-target boundary checks, leaf transformation ids, forward phases, and exact rewind phase ordering.

slices.title: Define KpBehavior time sampling protocol
slices.summary: Added the KpBehavior protocol with normalized sample context, clamped time sampling, progress sampling, invalid duration checks, and duration reparameterization that preserves semantic progress.

slices.title: Define timeline and event protocol
slices.summary: Added timeline specs with beats, events, checkpoints, pauses, active beat sampling, elapsed event sampling, duration clamping, and validation for beat/event ids and bounds.

slices.title: Define interpreter contract for render/export backends
slices.summary: Added a generic KP interpreter contract with target kinds, input kind, preservation level, normalized interpretation output, and explicit diagnostics for lax or lossy mappings.

slices.title: Define external deterministic port contract
slices.summary: Added an external port contract for deterministic imports into KP asset bundles, including source system/version metadata, preservation level, run wrapper, and explicit approximate/lossy/opaque/partial/unsupported diagnostics.

slices.title: Define flashcard spec contract
slices.summary: Added flashcard specs that reference asset ids, object ids, selector ids, transformation ids, time slices, and answers, plus validation so cards cannot silently drift from source assets.

slices.title: Add law-test helper utilities
slices.summary: Added reusable law helpers for behavior determinism, behavior duration reparameterization, and diagram rewind phase equivalence, with structured pass/failure results for future canonical examples.

slices.title: Wrap linear solve as an AssetBundle
slices.summary: Added a canonical linear-solve KP asset wrapper with manifest-aligned equation object ids, selector metadata, transformation contracts, correspondence maps, and a sequence diagram without changing the existing renderer.

slices.title: Map existing equation sampler into KpBehavior
slices.summary: Added createLinearSolveKpBehavior, a KpBehavior wrapper over the existing live linear-solve tutorial card sampler that preserves parent-timeline duration and deterministic progress sampling.

slices.title: Add pause-time asset inspection API
slices.summary: Added inspectKpBehaviorAt, a generic pause-time inspection helper that samples a KpBehavior at time and extracts active transformations, selectors, and phase metadata, including linear-solve coverage.

slices.title: Add transformation drill-down asset hook
slices.summary: Added a pure transformation drill-down hook API that resolves active pause-time inspections to explainer assets, validates hook uniqueness and parent transformation references, and exposes a canonical linear-solve cancellation explainer hook.

slices.title: Generate flashcard specs from the linear solve bundle
slices.summary: Added reusable linear-solve flashcards for cloze, predict-next, explain-transform, and selector-persistence focus prompts, all validated against the canonical asset bundle and transformation IDs.

slices.title: Add deterministic algebra-trace port fixture
slices.summary: Added a deterministic linear-solve algebra-trace fixture port that imports trace steps into the canonical KP bundle shape with explicit port provenance and strict preservation when the trace matches.

slices.title: Test algebra port composition and loss diagnostics
slices.summary: Added generic port determinism and loss-reporting law helpers, then verified the algebra-trace fixture imports deterministically and downgrades mismatched traces with explicit partial-loss diagnostics.

slices.title: Add program-trace asset skeleton
slices.summary: Added a semantic asset wrapper for the existing addition execution-trace fixture, including source-file and execution-step objects, sequential advanceExecutionTrace transformations, a diagram, and deterministic behavior sampling.

slices.title: Expose asset bundles, examples, flashcards, and ports in the dashboard
slices.summary: Added dashboard rows for the linear-solve asset bundle, generated flashcards, algebra-trace port fixture, and program-trace asset skeleton, with source refs, verification metadata, search coverage, and Theseus payload coverage.

slices.title: Write KP Asset Calculus readiness report card
slices.summary: Added a KP Asset Calculus readiness report and dashboard report-card theme summarizing current maturity, evidence, risks, and next actions across assets, ports, flashcards, law helpers, dashboard rows, and program-trace skeletons.

slices.title: Refresh roadmap and semantic runtime thread
slices.summary: Updated the KP roadmap and semantic runtime thread to treat Asset Calculus as implemented source infrastructure, with next priorities centered on renderer/interpreter adoption, law expansion, generated tutorial pressure tests, and fixture-first external ports.

slices.title: Close KP Asset Calculus loop
slices.summary: Added the KP Asset Calculus loop closeout report with structural improvements, unlocked behavior, verification evidence, residual risks, and recommended next slices for renderer/interpreter adoption.
